verdict.rationale: Fellow's feature page says teams can record 'with a visible bot or without one,' capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles and in-person meetings. Those meetings produce full searchable transcripts. Evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the desktop capture app is set up and works, explicit confirmation that external participants see no indicator, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
